zh-CN.title: DAWLoop 推出重大更新
zh-CN.body:
v0.5.6-alpha.2 现已推出（实验性预览版）。
全新音乐智能工作区、Basic Pitch 音频转 MIDI、Piano Roll 编辑体验。

en-US.title: A major DAWLoop update is available
en-US.body:
v0.5.6-alpha.2 is now available as an experimental preview.
Explore Music Intelligence, Basic Pitch audio-to-MIDI and Piano Roll editing.
View update details.
